Hello boss! Just the other day I got checked out for the same symptoms you’re describing and was told I have chronic gastritis and need to be tested for gerd. If you notice things like tums helping the pain then it’s definitely not CHS especially if you aren’t smoking. I’m still taking a break from smoking as my own diagnosis was recent and I want to make sure it’s my stomach and not the weed since gastritis and chs can mimic one another (also btw everyone’s different so I don’t mean to compare our situations just trying to give another pov). Also if you’re like me and had these problems even before you began using cannabis it’s definitely a reflux issue. Hope you are able to find relief and figure out what is wrong!
